summary: A compact Chinatown cocktail bar known for drinks built around Thai wild honey and less familiar herbs. It suits a deliberate one- or two-drink stop while exploring Soi Nana, with bartenders able to guide guests through local ingredients.
whyGo: Taste Thai honeys and regional botanicals in cocktails rather than a standard international bar menu.
The intimate room and close bartender interaction make the ingredients part of the experience.
It sits in Soi Nana’s Chinatown bar cluster, convenient to pair with dinner or other nearby bars.
bestFor: Cocktail drinkers curious about local ingredients and unusual flavour combinations.
A short evening stop in the Chinatown area.
skipIf: You need a spacious, quiet venue or guaranteed seating; the bar is described as small.
You want a confirmed low-cost night out or need step-free access; neither is established by current primary information.
duration: Allow about 1–2 hours for drinks; this is a planning estimate, not a published visit duration.
cost: Budget roughly ฿500–฿1,000 per person for one or two cocktails, using third-party menu/listing ranges as a guide. Prices and menu may change by December 2026; confirm before visiting.
hours: Listings conflict: older Time Out information says 2pm–1am, while newer third-party listings commonly show an evening opening around 5–6pm to 1am. Treat hours as unconfirmed and check @asia_today_bar shortly before going.
bestTime: Go near opening for a better chance of a seat and time to ask about the drinks; arrive earlier in the evening rather than assuming late-night availability. This is practical advice, not a guaranteed quiet period.
gettingThere: Use the map pin for 35 Soi Nana, Pom Prap, Chinatown/Yaowarat. Hua Lamphong MRT is the nearest commonly listed station; allow extra time for the final walk and verify the route in a current map app. The address is distinct from Sukhumvit’s Nana area.
booking: No verified official booking channel or December availability was found. Check the venue’s Instagram @asia_today_bar or contact details shown on a current listing before making a special trip; do not rely on walk-in seating at peak time.
accessibility: No reliable accessibility statement found. The small bar setting may be limiting for mobility devices; contact the venue directly about steps, doorway width, seating and toilet access before visiting.
